data.description: Fully physics based multiplayer. Built in mod support. Spawnable weapons, blades, tools, props, enemies, and more. Highly optimized for incredible multiplayer sandbox performance. Explore vast and breathtaking levels. Chat with friends over built in voice chat. Versatile weapons with many uses. Experimental gravity and scaling physics! More content coming soon!
